trust.heading: Secure by default.
trust.subheading: Your client data never leaves the EU. Built for the European market from day one.
trust.copy: EU-hosted infrastructure. GDPR-compliant and AI Act-ready. All data stored and transmitted encrypted. Connections are always read-only — Stevin never writes back to your platforms.
trust.pillar1_desc: Every client account runs in its own secure environment. No cross-contamination, ever.
trust.pillar2_desc: Stevin reads, never writes. We have no access to modify anything in your ad accounts.
trust.pillar3_desc: You always see why a signal was generated and on what data it is based.

home.hero_h1: Before revenue drops or budget leaks,
home.hero_sub: Stevin monitors your paid and owned media 24/7 and signals what changes — so you can act before it's too late.
home.domain_marketing_desc: Every euro traceable to results. No conflicting dashboards, no black boxes. Spend and results finally aligned.
home.domain_artists_desc: Hype isn't chance. Stevin traces which moments truly build momentum and helps you act before everyone else catches on.
home.connectors_label: Connected to 220+ data sources in real-time
home.problem_h2: You're missing the data that actually matters.
home.problem_sub: Your accounts generate thousands of data points per minute. Without context, it's all noise.
home.problem1_desc: The truth is spread across social media, ad platforms and e-commerce systems. Without connecting them, you're flying blind.
home.problem2_desc: Dashboards tell you what happened yesterday. Your client is paying for what needs to happen tomorrow. Nobody benefits from a 40-page PDF.
home.problem3_desc: Five people on reporting, zero on strategy. Exporting, combining, formatting — time that should go to creation, optimisation or client work.
home.engine_h2: When the data is right, the fog lifts.
home.step1_desc: All raw data from 220+ sources in real-time in one overview. No middleware, no delays.
home.step2_desc: Platform figures next to reality in your CRM. Where Meta or Google diverges, it becomes measurable.
home.step3_desc: Concrete action points per euro. Stevin tells you where to steer tomorrow.
home.step4_desc: The platform learns from every interaction. Reports and advice adapt to your way of working.
home.benefits_h2: Ready to use. Not for a proof of concept.
home.benefit1_desc: Connections activated, first signals visible. No months-long implementation trajectory.
home.benefit2_desc: AI signals, you decide. No autonomous actions without your approval.
home.benefit3_desc: Built by marketers, for marketers. Stevin understands the difference between a spike and a structural problem.
home.benefit4_desc: Every interaction makes the system sharper. Advice improves the longer you work with it.
home.result_desc: Whether you manage dozens of ad accounts for clients, or monitor the cross-channel interactions of millions of fans: Stevin scales with you.
home.stat2_label: Native integrations out of the box
home.closing_eyebrow: It's not a wonder. It's Stevin.

diensten.sub: No package lists. No modules with checkboxes. A working platform that brings spend and results into alignment — in combinations that fit you.
diensten.tracks_h2: One platform. Three ways it works alongside you.
diensten.tracks_sub: Choose what fits. Combine, switch, scale — the benchmark stays the same.
diensten.track1_body: You get Stevin running on your own stack. 220+ integrations, Director layer, CRM integration, causal reports. Your consultant or we manage it.

diensten.track3_body: Your agency runs Stevin under your own brand. We provide the engine, you provide the face to the client. For agencies that want transparency as a differentiator.
diensten.closing_eyebrow: It's not a wonder. It's Stevin.
diensten.closing_h2: Not sure which track? We'll sort that in one conversation.
